name: template7
description: Event program schedule template with structured program planning
system_instructions: Generate engaging and practical event program content that highlights activities, locations, and team-building opportunities. Be concise and specific.

table:programme.label: Program Schedule
table:programme.description: Table with activities for each time slot across event days
table:programme.instructions: For each time slot (Matinée, Après-midi, Soirée, etc.), return an ARRAY of paragraphs. Each item in the array should be a separate paragraph. Structure as follows: 1) context - a description paragraph of activities and logistics. 2) team_building (optional) - if provided, generate a paragraph about the team building activity including: action (what it is), objective (what it aims to achieve), experience (immersive/competitive nature), and les_plus (why it's beneficial for the team + key bonuses). 3) offers (optional) - array of individual offering paragraphs, each describing one benefit/offering. Return the time slot value as an array where each element is a separate paragraph. Example: ['Context paragraph...', 'Team Building paragraph...', 'Offering 1...', 'Offering 2...'].

formatting_conventions.name: activity_name
formatting_conventions.instruction: When mentioning activity or session names, wrap with $$activity$$Activity Name$$activity$$

formatting_conventions.name: location
formatting_conventions.instruction: When mentioning specific locations, venues, or rooms, wrap with $$location$$Location Name$$location$$

formatting_conventions.name: team_building
formatting_conventions.instruction: When describing team building activities or challenges, wrap with $$team$$Activity Name$$team$$

formatting_conventions.name: duration
formatting_conventions.instruction: When specifying durations or time slots, wrap with $$time$$Duration$$time$$
